description: A photo gallery with a dialog for the selected picture. Additive to Photo gallery.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Photos in a grid, a masonry of mixed heights, or a featured picture over thumbnails, with a dialog that shows
  the selected photo. Static markup: the dialog open state is a prop. Axes: layout (grid, masonry, featured),
  captions (show, hide), lightbox (open, closed).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { LightboxLabels } from "./lightbox-gallery.types";
import type { Photo } from "./photo-gallery.types";

export type LightboxGalleryProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  photos: Photo[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: LightboxLabels;
  layout?: "grid" | "masonry" | "featured";
  captions?: "show" | "hide";
  lightbox?: "open" | "closed";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import FigureBlock from "../components/figure-block.vue";
import LightboxStage from "../components/lightbox-stage.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  photos,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  layout = "grid",
  captions = "show",
  lightbox = "closed",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<LightboxGalleryProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((photos?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="image" :title="empty" />
    <template v-else>
      <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'featured')" gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="featured">
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" />
        <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {{ photos[0]?.title ?? "" }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ tpl(labels.counter, 1, (photos?.length ?? 0)) }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Group gap="2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" layout="icon" type="button" :aria-label="labels.previous">
              <LucideIcon name="chevron-left" :size="16" />
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" layout="icon" type="button" :aria-label="labels.next">
              <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" :size="16" />
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Group>
        <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-9" data-testid="thumbs">
          <MediaFrame
            v-for="(p, i) in photos"
            :key="p.id"
            :alt="p.title"
            ratio="1/1"
            :class="((i === 0) ? 'ring-2 ring-foreground' : '')"
          />
        </Box>
      </Stack>
      <Box v-else
        :class="
          (layout as string) === 'masonry' ? 'columns-1 gap-4 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3'
          : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
        "
        data-testid="items"
      >
        <FigureBlock v-for="(p, i) in photos" :key="p.id"
          :class="cn(
            'relative flex flex-col gap-2',
            (((layout as string) === 'masonry') ? 'mb-4 break-inside-avoid' : '')
          )"
          testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame
            :alt="p.title"
            :ratio="
              (layout as string) === 'masonry' ? ((p.size === 'tall') ? '3/4' : ((p.size === 'wide') ? '16/9' : ((p.size === 'large') ? '4/3' : '1/1')))
              : '4/3'
            "
          />
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            type="button"
            class="absolute right-2 top-2 bg-background"
            :aria-label="labels.open"
            data-testid="open"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="arrow-up-right" :size="16" />
          </Button>
          <Box
            v-if="(((captions as string) === 'show') && (((layout as string) === 'grid') || ((layout as string) === 'masonry')))"
            class="text-sm text-muted-foreground"
            data-testid="caption"
          >
            {{ p.title }}
          </Box>
        </FigureBlock>
      </Box>
      <LightboxStage :photos="photos" :labels="labels" :captions="captions" :lightbox="lightbox" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
